Ask the Water

SPEAKING · SPEECH FUNCTIONS · GRADE 8 SCIENCE

The Directions

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The evidence board

As you record, the four numbers fill in. Pair each stone with its water, then compare the two tests.

400 gTEST 1 STONE
+5 °CTEST 1 WATER
800 gTEST 2 STONE
+10 °CTEST 2 WATER
LESS HEATMORE HEAT

The Scene

Your class is having a trial about two hot stone tests. You speak for one side. The other side says a different kind of rock made the water hotter. Both tests used the same amount of water. You need four numbers for your evidence board. Four people each have one number.

The History

Many First Nations people cooked with hot stones. They heated the stones in a fire. Then they put the stones into water. The hot stones made the water hot enough to cook.
